values.binNote: Per-tick figure derived by dividing the total (BaseDamage/1x AP) by 4 ticks; matches BaseDamage/4 and AP ratio/4.

No single bin row states this sum; it is the wiki's precomputed total of per-attack DamagePerc x NumAttacks=3 (0.7*3=2.1 ... 1.1*3=3.3), derivable from the two named rows but not literally present in either.

values.meaning: Hyper Charge's own cooldown (separate from W's listed cooldown)
values.binNote: Not shown in the ddragon cooldown array quoted at the top of this dossier ([10]x6), which belongs to the Lightning Field sub-ability; this is the separate Hyper Charge cooldown row in the bin.
Wiki states the empower window as 4 seconds; the bin's JayceHyperCharge.Duration is 3.6. This is a wiki/bin disagreement, not restated as the bin's number.

values.meaning: Hyper Charge number of empowered attacks

mechanics.claim: Jayce's basic attacks restore mana on-hit while this passive is active, including against structures.
Lightning Field's cooldown starts on cast, not when the field ends.
Hyper Charge's cooldown only starts after the empowered attacks finish (or the window expires), not on cast.
Hyper Charge's last empowered attack is evaluated on-hit rather than on-attack, so other on-hit effects landing first (e.g. Runaan's, Guinsoo's) prevent it from modifying that attack's damage.
mechanics.quote: The last basic attack is checked [[on-hit]] rather than [[on-attack]].

mechanics.claim: Hyper Charge resets Jayce's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Hyper Charge {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Jayce's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: Hyper Charge's total modified damage can crit.
mechanics.quote: ''Hyper Charge's'' '''total''' damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
